messages:
izzy: Quick note  repro where Console briefly shows rows from the wrong workspace after fast nav. Traced to routing baggage header leaking into connector fetch.

cal: steps to repro?

izzy: repro on canary: rapid switch between workspaces A->B, open insights immediately. Logs show header X-Routing-Baggage: prev=A but auth says B, and connector returned rows for A.

cal: likely connection-level metadata (baggage) being applied as a fetch hint. We treated it as advisory but some fast paths apply it.

izzy: exact log (sanitized):
```
INFO router req=rp71 headers={"X-Org-ID":"B","X-Routing-Baggage":"prev=A"} conn=conn-11
INFO connector fetch hint=prev=A returned_rows=3
```

cal: mitigation: strip advisory baggage at edge and add a strict-check on connector checkout. small pseudocode:
```go
if req.Headers.Has("X-Routing-Baggage") {
  metrics.Inc("routing.baggage_stripped")
  req.Headers.Del("X-Routing-Baggage")
}
// on checkout
if conn.Affinity != req.Headers.Get("X-Org-ID") {
  metrics.Inc("connector.affinity_mismatch")
  conn.Close()
  // retry once on fresh conn
}
```

ops-bot: deploy started: router/strip-baggage v0.1 -> canary (5%) by cal at 2025-06-12T11:00:00Z

support: UX ask: surface a subtle non-blocking toast for affected orgs: "Updating workspace view  validating content" behind flag `ui.strip_baggage_toast`. reduces alarm.

cal: added metric tags {route,auth_org} so support can filter noisy orgs. plan: patch -> canary -> monitor `routing.baggage_stripped` and `connector.affinity_mismatch` for 24h -> full rollout if stable.

ops-bot: deploy complete: router/strip-baggage v0.1 -> canary (5%) by cal at 2025-06-12T11:06:39Z

izzy: monitoring shows a handful of strips on canary and zero downstream affinity leaks so far. will follow up with a short checklist to audit other advisory headers. :thumbsup:
